content:
@Kim Morrison At the ongoing FC workshop, @Moritz Firsching @Paul Lezeau and I discussed the comparator integration with FC. Much of the current PR (FC#4951) importer’s complexity comes from copying FC definitions and notation and reconstructing Lean source context in Python. That makes it brittle and harder to maintain.

Could generated workspaces instead import an explicitly pinned FC package? FC would handle statement and answer extraction using Lean, while the generator would preserve package imports and include the pinned dependencies in the generated Lakefile.

This would simplify the FC importer and appears to require a moderate generator change, while preserving compatibility with existing requests.

We opened draft PRs in FC and Lean-Eval Generator to prototype this

FC PR: https://github.com/google-deepmind/formal-conjectures/pull/5337
Lean Eval Generator PR: https://github.com/leanprover/lean-eval-generator/pull/7
